title: PE's Optional Header Magic determines PE32 or PE32+ layout
summary: Magic 0x10b corresponds to PE32, and 0x20b corresponds to PE32+. PE32+ omit BaseOfData and expand some fields.
detail: You cannot just expand all four-byte numbers of PE32 into eight bytes. You should read Magic first, and then explain ImageBase and data directories according to their corresponding structures.
boundary: The Machine field describes the schema and cannot replace checking the Optional Header itself and its length.
relevance: Avoid overall misalignment of the structure due to incorrect selection when locating the image base address or directory table.
